title: 1920s Outdoor Family Portrait, Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A late 1920s outdoor family snapshot capturing a father, mother, and three young children posed in front of a small pine tree and a wooded backdrop. The mother wears a period-accurate cloche hat and coat, while the father sits holding an infant. Another child sits on the grass, and a young boy stands on the right in an overcoat. The front white border features a blue ink inscription reading 'my sister + family'.
